title: Live-traffic‑prioritized mini-bundles for quant calibration
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: create small, per-domain calibration 'mini-bundles' derived from live production traffic that prioritize recent, high-confidence error modes for FP8/INT8 calibration runs and downstream accuracy validation. These mini-bundles should be compact (1–5k examples per domain) and curated automatically from streaming logs so they can be used for continuous regression checks and fast quant-profile iterations.

Motivation: Full production prompt replay sets are large and expensive to re-run for every quant profile candidate. We need a lightweight, high-signal dataset that captures the prompt distributions and failure modes relevant to per-domain workloads, enables quick FP8/INT8 calibration experiments, and preserves user privacy constraints.

Scope: design selection criteria, sampling pipeline, cadence for bundle rotation, validation metrics, and integration points with the calibration CLI and the regression dashboard. Deliverables: sampling service spec, SQL/sketch queries for traffic signals, prototype mini-bundle generation job, docs for model team usage, and a dashboard tile for tracking bundle drift and quantization impact.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible pipeline that produces per-domain mini-bundles from last-30d traffic within budget (<=2h compute and <=10GB disk per run)
Bundles contain 500–5000 examples, with configurable stratification parameters per domain
Quant calibration runs (FP8 and INT8) using mini-bundles show correlation >=0.85 with full replay accuracy delta on held-out months
Automated privacy filters applied (PII masking and opt-out exclusion) and logs documenting filtering rate
CI integration: a PR that proposes a new quant-profile must trigger a calibration job against the domain bundle and post a regression report to the console pipeline
implementation_notes: Sampling signals: mix of recency weight (exponential decay, half-life configurable), failure importance (log-prob delta > threshold), top-k route coverage, and token-length buckets
Use reservoir-with-rescore approach: lightweight reservoir sample over 30d then rescore by composite importance and trim to target size
Context handling: preserve up to domain-specific context length (configurable) and canonicalize trailing whitespace/prompt templates to aggregate duplicates
Privacy: run PII detection heuristics (regex + model-based classifier) and drop or redact examples that match high-confidence PII; maintain opt-out list from consent store
Storage: bundles written to S3 prefix s3://redwood-calibration/mini-bundles/{domain}/{YYYY-MM-DD}/{bundle-id}.ndjson
Provenance: embed metadata header (domain, created_at, signals-used, sampling-seed, filter-stats) in bundle object metadata
Backwards compatibility: expose a stable CLI flag --bundle-path for calibration jobs and a mapping in the console to pin a bundle to a release
test_plan: Unit tests for sampler: validate stratification, decayed weighting, reservoir behavior with synthetic traffic traces
Integration test: end-to-end job runs on replay dataset mirror producing bundles under resource budget
Correlation test: compare calibration deltas on mini-bundle vs full replay for 5 recent quant candidates across three domains (chat, search, summarization)
Performance test: ensure bundle generation latency and cost targets are met when run on standard batch fleet
Canary: roll out bundle-driven calibration on a staging customer and monitor qualitative differences in logits and top-1 outputs
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: mini-bundles overfit to recent anomalies and miss long-tail regressions. Mitigation: maintain a parallel periodic 'backstop' sampling of older months and include a tail quota in each bundle
Risk: PII leakage despite heuristics. Mitigation: conservative redaction by default and sampling audit logs with differential sampling for manual review
Risk: correlation with full-replay accuracy is insufficient. Mitigation: tune composite importance formula and increase bundle size for low-correlation domains
Risk: cost/perf of generating bundles for 100+ domains. Mitigation: prioritize top-N revenue domains for daily bundles and use weekly batches for low-traffic domains
milestones: M1: spec and sampling algorithm proposal (2025-03-07)
M2: prototype sampler + one-domain E2E run (2025-03-14)
M3: multi-domain scale test and dashboard tile (2025-03-21)
M4: enable CLI gating and CI integration (2025-03-28)
